CONMED Corporation is a progressive, global medical device company, operating in 20 countries. Through thoughtful leadership, innovation and teamwork, we are changing the future of healthcare. Our 3,500 employees worldwide make meaningful contributions, positively impact the business, and advance in their careers as our company and product portfolio grows.

We are a leader in Orthopedics, General Surgery, Gynecology, Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Anesthesiology and our employees enjoy challenging and diverse job opportunities across these varied specializations. CONMED is headquartered in the United States. Our international presence includes more than 20 locations throughout Canada, Europe, Australia, Latin America, Asia, North America, and the Middle East.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Finance Director for Brazil is responsible for leading all financial operations, ensuring full compliance with local regulations, strengthening internal controls, optimizing financial performance, developing and supporting strategic business objectives. This role is pivotal in elevating governance, audit readiness, and operational discipline across the Brazilian organization.

This role oversees FP&A, Controllership, Reporting, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Internal Controls, Compliance, and Financial Governance, while partnering closely with the Country Manager and regional/global Finance leadership to drive sustainable growth, profitability, strong governance and disciplined execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic & Financial Leadership

  • Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with corporate objectives and Brazil’s dynamic economic and regulatory environment.
  • Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, cash planning, and long‑range planning processes for Brazil.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Country Manager and senior leadership team, providing actionable insights to influence commercial, operational, and organizational decisions.
  • Monitor market trends, FX volatility, reimbursement dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitor behavior to inform financial strategy.

Financial Reporting, Compliance & Audit Readiness

  • Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely reporting under Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate accounting standards (including US GAAP, if applicable).
  • Ensure complete, timely, and compliant statutory reporting, tax filings, SPED obligations (ECD/ECF), and other regulatory submissions.
  • Lead the Brazil Audit Remediation Plan, ensuring closure of all audit findings (high/medium/low risk) within established timelines.
  • Strengthen governance, documentation discipline, and financial process transparency to achieve “audit‑ready, always” standards.
  • Manage external relationships with auditors (Big 4), tax authorities, banks, and regulatory bodies, representing the company with professionalism and financial rigor.

Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

  • Own end‑to‑end cash flow, liquidity planning, and working capital performance (AR, AP, inventory).
  • Lead banking relationships, credit facility management, financial instruments, FX operations, and covenant monitoring.
  • Optimize capital structure, credit utilization, hedging strategies, and funding needs in alignment with corporate Treasury.
  • Drive improvements in collections, DSO, inventory turns, and payment terms to enhance cash generation.

Performance Management & Business Partnering

  • Deliver comprehensive financial analysis, including P&L performance, balance sheet quality, KPI trends, pricing, and margin enhancement opportunities.
  • Evaluate commercial strategies, business cases, investments, and distributor economics across franchises, customers, and Brazil geographies.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to improve pricing governance, cost‑to‑serve, product mix optimization, and portfolio profitability.

Internal Controls, Governance & Risk Management

  • Design, implement, and continuously strengthen internal controls aligned with SOX, corporate governance frameworks, and Brazilian regulatory requirements.
  • Lead governance of Fixed‑asset tracking and mobility controls, Inventory accuracy, reconciliations, and reporting reliability (including 3PL and distributor consignment).
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive risk register, governance cadence, and audit calendar.

Systems, ERP & Digital Finance

  • Lead optimization and governance of ERP and reporting systems, improving data integrity, and reporting accuracy.
  • Implement analytics and BI tools to enhance management dashboards, forecasting, and business decision‑making.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high‑performing Finance organization across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Controls.
  • Build strong bench strength and raise capability in financial governance, technical accounting, tax, and analytics.
  • Lead the team through transformational change, strengthening culture, accountability, and execution discipline.
  • Foster effective cross‑functional partnerships with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Service teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  • Minimum 7–10 years in senior finance leadership roles (Finance Director, Country Controller, CFO, or equivalent) within multinational environments.
  • Proven experience in a similar leadership role or demonstrated potential to successfully assume such responsibilities.
  • Proven track record in governance turnarounds, internal controls design, and complex compliance environments.
  • Significant experience managing cash flow, working capital, treasury, and banking relationships.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Accounting, FP&A, Tax (including indirect taxes), Treasury, and statutory reporting.
  • Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or medical devices preferred; understanding of distributors and regulated markets is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of Brazil’s financial, tax, and regulatory landscape.
  • Strong command of Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate reporting frameworks including US GAAP.
  • Advanced analytical thinking with ability to translate data into insights and influence senior decision‑makers.
  • Strong systems orientation, with hands‑on ERP experience (SAP/Oracle) and BI/reporting tools.
  • Exceptional communication skills in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive accountability, lead change, and elevate organizational capability.
  • High degree of integrity, assertiveness, discipline, and ownership in managing financial governance.

Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (required).
  • MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Controllership, or related field (preferred).
  • Professional certification such as CRC, CPA, CMA, or equivalent strongly preferred.
  • Additional credentials in internal controls, audit, or compliance are a plus.

title: Technical Program Manager II
description:
About us

WEX is a global commerce platform that helps businesses solve operational complexities like employee benefits, managing and mobilizing fleets, and streamlining payments.

With over 5,500 employees, we work with large and small companies in more than 200 countries and territories, and can tailor our services to meet the unique needs of their businesses.

A Technical Program Manager is a key partner to the Technology leaders and their Digital counterparts in driving and assisting successful delivery of technology outcomes. You will be responsible for driving delivery on projects and initiatives within one or more Technology areas.

As a TPM II at WEX, you will focus on enabling execution, coordinating across technology teams, tracking project progress, and ensuring delivery against defined plans. You will play a key role partnering with Technology leaders and other teams to drive delivery of initiatives that support more efficient ways of working for WEX's employees, as part of the Employee Technical Services team's mission. Your primary focus will be on managing the execution of projects centered on internal hardware, tooling and software that supports a more efficient and delightful employee experience. You will coordinate and lead efforts across cross-functional teams to plan, execute, and deliver software and tools that enable our employees to succeed in their roles, using efficient cutting‑edge technologies. You will also work closely with technical partners to execute and enable migrations and consolidations of internal tooling solutions.

The Technical Program Management Office (TPMO) is a strategic function of the Technology Innovation & Strategic Operations (TISO) department within WEX. Our mission is to accelerate WEX’s product innovation velocity by optimizing how we deliver technology. We accelerate technology delivery at WEX by optimizing program execution across all technology domains.

How you’ll make an impact

Technical Fluency

  • Manage the execution of internal tooling initiatives and platform migration / consolidation projects, including improvements to development workflows, automation systems, and application / service modernization.
  • Collaborate with application architects, platform engineers, data specialists, and internal tooling teams to document project scope, milestones, and success criteria.
  • Develop detailed work breakdown structures, execution plans, and project roadmaps for tooling enhancements, system consolidation efforts, and cross‑platform migrations.
  • Oversee project and sub‑initiative execution that streamlines internal platforms, standardizes tooling across teams, and improves operational efficiency, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Partner with platform and tooling engineering teams to ensure seamless migration, deployment, and operational readiness of internal systems and shared services.
  • Coordinate efforts across engineering and security teams to modernize shared tools, integrate authentication and authorization systems, and ensure internal services meet compliance and governance requirements.
  • Manage dependencies related to application routing, service integrations, environment configurations, and monitoring / logging toolchains to support reliable and consistent internal operations.

Program Planning / Continuous Planning: Based on Product and Technology leadership direction and priorities, facilitate ongoing planning sessions and huddles to ensure continuous alignment with business goals within and across your portfolio. This will require close cross‑functional partnership with technology team leaders, solution architects, and product partners. Ensure alignment of program increments with overall business goals and priorities. Encourage adaptive planning within the project team to respond to changing delivery and project requirements.

Program Management

Own and drive end‑to‑end technical implementation projects and workstreams as assigned. You’ll detailed work breakdowns, milestones, risks, and deliverables for key project initiatives, and execute project plans in partnership with engineering leadership. On an ongoing basis, support and execute against the team’s enhancement roadmap for systems, tools, and processes.

Execution Management

In support of the Tech Lead, monitor progress and recommend necessary adjustments to surface risks of program execution to key stakeholders in a targeted and timely way, with the goal of course correction. Facilitate these course corrections, as needed.

Stakeholder and Change Management

Engage with stakeholders — Technology, Product, Solution Architecture, among others — to ensure visibility, provide updates, and address concerns. Facilitate communication between teams, ensuring transparency and alignment. Provide clear, consistent, and timely information flow and reports out on status. Work collaboratively at project and stakeholder levels to facilitate and enable change to support new ways of working and modern technology architectures.

Risk Management

Identify technical risks related to implementation considerations for assigned projects. Assist in developing mitigation strategies with technical partners.

Dependency Management

Identify, document, and track dependencies within the scope of your projects and across adjacent teams. Proactively coordinate with stakeholders to ensure dependencies are clearly understood and addressed.

Tooling and Data Hygiene

Accordingly, ensure the use of standard project management tools — ideally within the Atlassian suite — and maintain high standards of data hygiene to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity. Support accurate and transparent reporting and on‑target capitalization within the organization through data stewardship.

Delivery and Outcome Tracking

Track project performance against the committed plan and goals. Use data and metrics to support decision‑making and continuous improvement at the project level.

Experience you’ll bring

Relevant experience in technical program management managing projects or complex sub‑initiatives focused on internal tooling and capabilities. An ideal candidate has a blend of technical acumen and strong project management skills to drive execution within cross‑functional initiatives. They are comfortable working in ambiguous or fast‑paced environments and excel at executing detailed project plans. They are passionate about implementing solutions and communicating effectively with project and mid‑level stakeholders.

Technical Skills

  • Experience managing application and service migrations, such as consolidating services into shared platforms, migrating legacy applications to modern frameworks, or transitioning internal systems across environments.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and microservice architectures, including service discovery, API gateways, internal routing, and inter‑service communication patterns.
  • Understanding of database and data platform migrations, including schema evolution, data validation, ETL workflow transitions, and consolidation across environments or platforms.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance requirements, including identity integration (SSO / SAML / OIDC), role‑based access control, audit logging, and governance for internal tools.
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing platforms and services (AWS, Azure, GCP), including infrastructure‑as‑code and cloud security best practices.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management tools.

Leadership and Communication

  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative and execute within a project team.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross‑functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

Problem‑Solving

Ability to identify potential risks and issues at the project level and proactively support their mitigation or resolution in partnership with technology leadership. Analytical mindset with strong execution capabilities.

Desired qualifications & experiences

  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Agile Certified Practitioner).
  • Previous experience in FinTech or highly regulated environments.

Why This Role Matters


This role is central to how our creative machine runs. As a UGC coordinator, you ensure that ideas turn into real, usable content—on time, organized, and ready to perform. Your work directly impacts creative velocity, team alignment, and overall results.

About Envana

Envana is a sustainability technology and consulting company helping energy and industrial organizations measure, manage, and reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Our software platform delivers the data accuracy and transparency required for robust emissions measurement and reporting, while our consulting team provides the technical and strategic expertise to turn data into action.

Together, we support clients in building credible decarbonisation pathways, strengthening methane management programs, meeting evolving regulatory and voluntary reporting requirements (including OGMP 2.0), and achieving measurable emissions reductions.

At Envana, our people are our greatest strength. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture built on high support and high challenge, where curiosity is encouraged, innovation is rewarded, and individuals are empowered to take ownership of meaningful work. If you thrive in a dynamic environment and want to contribute to solving one of the world’s most critical climate challenges, Envana is the place to make an impact.

About the Opportunity

Envana is expanding its Sustainability and Decarbonisation practice in South America and is seeking an experienced SME – Methane & OGMP (Oil & Gas) to support and lead client engagements across the region.

This role focuses on helping oil & gas and energy-sector clients improve the accuracy of their greenhouse gas inventories, design and implement methane measurement and mitigation programs, and align with OGMP 2.0, MRV best practices, and international reporting frameworks.

As an experienced SME, you will work closely with operators, technical teams, and sustainability leaders to move beyond emissions reporting toward measurement-informed emissions management and abatement. The role combines deep technical expertise in methane and GHG accounting with client-facing advisory, data integration, and strategic decarbonisation support.

This position offers an opportunity to play a key role in shaping Envana’s advisory presence in South America and supporting regional operators as methane regulation, transparency, and performance expectations continue to evolve.

This role is open to candidates based anywhere in South America.

Key Responsibilities

Client Delivery & Technical Leadership

  • Lead consulting engagements focused on methane quantification, MRV, and OGMP 2.0 alignment for oil & gas and energy-sector clients.
  • Support the development of measurement-informed GHG inventories, including reconciliation of bottom-up and top-down methane estimates.
  • Design and support methane mitigation and abatement programs, including source identification, prioritisation, and performance tracking.
  • Advise clients on improving emissions data quality, assurance readiness, and alignment with international frameworks (OGMP 2.0, GHG Protocol, IPCC).
  • Translate complex technical emissions data into clear, actionable insights for technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Provide technical review and quality assurance across deliverables to ensure analytical rigour and consistency.
  • Work closely with Envana’s software platform to integrate consulting insights into emissions measurement, reporting, and analytics tools.
  • Support proposal development and client pitches related to methane management, OGMP 2.0, and emissions strategy.
  • Build trusted relationships with regional operators, consultants, and partners across South America.
  • Identify emerging opportunities related to methane regulation, voluntary initiatives, and performance-based reporting.
  • Contribute to Envana’s growth strategy in South America by helping position the firm as a trusted partner in methane and emissions management.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge development around methane quantification, OGMP 2.0 implementation, and MRV best practices.
  • Contribute to thought leadership (presentations, technical notes, webinars) related to methane management and data-driven decarbonisation.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 6–10 years of experience in GHG accounting, methane quantification, MRV, or oil & gas sustainability consulting.
  • Demonstrated experience with OGMP 2.0, methane inventories, emissions validation, or related reporting frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of GHG Protocol, IPCC methodologies, and measurement-based emissions approaches.
  • Experience working with upstream oil & gas, LNG, or energy-sector clients.
  • Proven ability to lead or significantly contribute to client engagements in a consulting or advisory environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Fluency in English required; Spanish and / or Portuguese strongly preferred.
  • Degree in engineering, environmental science, sustainability, or a related field; postgraduate qualification is a plus.

Why Join Envana

  • Play a key role in expanding Envana’s advisory presence in South America.
  • Work on some of the most pressing challenges in methane management and decarbonisation.
  • Combine technical advisory work with cutting-edge emissions measurement technology.
  • Join a purpose-driven, high-growth company delivering measurable climate impact.

Jolera stands as a distinguished multinational Global Systems Integrator (GSI), a vanguard in delivering comprehensive and bespoke IT solutions to a diverse clientele, encompassing both direct customers and channel partners across the globe. At Jolera, we believe in empowering organizations worldwide with innovative and reliable IT solutions, and we invite you to join us in this mission.

Who You Are

We are seeking a skilled Senior Microsoft 365 Migration Specialist with proven experience planning and executing migrations across Microsoft cloud workloads. The ideal candidate has hands‑on experience using industry‑leading tools and native Microsoft solutions to transition enterprise environments to modern cloud platforms, with a focus on SharePoint, Exchange, and Active Directory integrations.

What You’ll Do

  • Plan and execute data migrations across Microsoft 365 workloads with minimal disruption to business operations. This includes applying expertise in M365 / O365 tenant management, licensing optimization, and customization.
  • Migrate SharePoint environments from on‑premises (e.g., SharePoint 2010) to SharePoint Online using tools such as ShareGate, including development of intranet solutions, document management, and workflow automation.
  • Perform tenant‑to‑tenant migrations within Microsoft 365, including SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, and Teams.
  • Implement, govern, and integrate Microsoft Teams with other Microsoft 365 services for enhanced collaboration.
  • Migrate mailboxes between Exchange Online tenants using cloud migration platforms such as BitTitan.
  • Import legacy email data (e.g., PST files) into Exchange Online using native Microsoft tools including the Import Service and AzCopy.
  • Configure OneDrive setup, optimization, and troubleshooting for seamless file synchronization and secure storage.
  • Manage endpoint security through Intune for comprehensive mobile device management (MDM), application deployment, and compliance policies.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders to analyze source / destination environments, identify risks, and define cutover / migration plans.
  • Map identities between environments using Active Directory (AD) and Azure Active Directory (Azure AD), ensuring security enhancements and seamless SSO integration across Microsoft services.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to permissions, throttling, unsupported features, or migration failures.
  • Maintain documentation and reporting for migration status, logs, and validation.

Main requirements

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 administration and migrations, with expertise in tenant management, migrations, licensing optimization, and customization.

  • Hands‑on experience with Migration tools such as Sharegate, BitTitan, etc.
  • Working knowledge of Exchange Online migrations.
  • Familiarity with native Microsoft tools for PST ingestion and data import.
  • Understanding of SharePoint Online architecture, site collections, document libraries, and permission models.
  • Proficiency with Azure AD, Azure storage accounts, and authentication models, including identity management, security enhancements, and seamless SSO integration.
  • Experience with Intune for comprehensive mobile device management (MDM) and compliance policies.
  • Experience with OneDrive setup, optimization, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and experience working in enterprise‑scale environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., MS‑100, MS‑101, SC‑300, AZ‑104)
  • Scripting experience (e.g., PowerShell) for bulk operations or automation
  • Experience with Microsoft Teams implementation, governance, and cross‑service migrations.
  • Exposure to hybrid environments (on‑prem AD with Azure AD Sync)

Benefits & Perks

Why Jolera

  • Join a fast‑scaling global organization with clients across multiple continents.
  • Engage in high‑impact M&A and transformation projects that shape enterprise IT strategy.
  • Collaborate with a global team of technologists and strategists who thrive on innovation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product

Location & Working Hours

  • Brazil-based fully remote

What We Offer

  • Market‑aligned compensation with outcome‑based variable tied to GRR/NRR
  • Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go‑live in a PRM or partner‑portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time‑to‑first‑value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

Especialista técnico e principal ponto de suporte ao cliente responsável por diagnosticar e executar reparos complexos em geradores e componentes diretamente no local do cliente.

  • Realizar treinamentos conforme exigido por competências e necessidades do negócio;
  • Manter veículo de serviço e ferramentas em condições adequadas de limpeza e funcionamento;
  • Garantir conformidade com normas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, reportando incidentes e problemas ao gestor do local e supervisor.

Competências:

  • Comunicação eficaz Desenvolver e transmitir comunicações claras, adequadas a diferentes públicos.
  • Foco no cliente Construir relações sólidas e entregar soluções centradas no cliente.
  • Desenvolvimento de talentos Apoiar o desenvolvimento profissional de pessoas alinhado a objetivos individuais e organizacionais.
  • Gestão da complexidade Interpretar informações complexas e por vezes contraditórias para resolver problemas.
  • Gestão de conflitos Conduzir situações de conflito de forma efetiva e com mínimo impacto.
  • Autodesenvolvimento Buscar crescimento contínuo por meios formais e informais.

  • Aplicação de Diagnóstico Interpretar reclamações de clientes e elaborar plano de diagnóstico; solucionar problemas com fluxos guiados, equipamentos mecânicos/eletrônicos e softwares; validar reparo e registrar resultados para rastreabilidade e pagamento.
  • Aplicação de Ferramentas Eletrônicas de Serviço Identificar e utilizar ferramentas de hardware e software adequadas para diagnóstico e manutenção.
  • Interações de Sistemas de Motor Analisar o funcionamento integrado de sistemas elétricos e mecânicos (exaustão, aquecimento, refrigeração, combustível, transmissão, tratamento, controles e sensores) utilizando ferramentas e materiais técnicos para diagnosticar e reparar corretamente.
  • Conhecimento de Sistemas de Geração de Energia Demonstrar conhecimento de padrões Cummins e do setor, interpretar e analisar o funcionamento de sistemas e sua integração (painéis, UPS, controles e comandos), aplicando ferramentas e documentação técnica para diagnóstico e reparo.
  • Reparo e Manutenção de Produtos Reparar e manter produtos eletromecânicos, desmontar, montar e substituir componentes seguindo padrões, ferramentas e diretrizes de reutilização de peças, minimizando custos e restabelecendo o equipamento em condições ideais.
  • Documentação de Serviço Criar e validar informações técnicas, registrar dados com ferramentas necessárias e seguir procedimentos para manter registro preciso dos serviços realizados.
  • Escalonamento Técnico Coletar dados sobre problemas técnicos, utilizar recursos internos (incluindo bancos de dados) e encaminhar questões complexas ao nível adequado, registrando etapas de diagnóstico para suporte e resolução correta de chamados.
  • Valoriza diferenças Reconhecer o valor de perspectivas e culturas diversas dentro da organização.

  • Conhecimento em grupos geradores, incluindo paralelismo, start-up, análise e diagnóstico de falhas;
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura e interpretação de manuais técnicos);

Nessa trajetória, assumimos um papel de referência na venda de peças para veículos pesados (ônibus, caminhões, picapes e máquinas agrícolas) e hoje trabalhamos um portfólio com aproximadamente 200 marcas, desde produtos nacionais até importados, sempre com os melhores fornecedores do mercado.

Missão:

Oferecer soluções na comercialização de peças e insumos para veículos de motorização diesel através de disponibilidade, venda consultiva e excelência no atendimento.

Valores:

Foco no Cliente, Conhecimento Técnico, Relacionamento, Respeito, Simplicidade e Resultado.

A gente resolve junto.

  • Garantir a realização de inventários rotativos e o controle dos estoques;

title: Viral Video Content Creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role. We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads.

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools

Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily

Success Criteria

First 30 days: Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.

Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).

Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).

Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.

By 90 days Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.

Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).

Maintain a simple testing system : what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.

Become independent : you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.

By 12 months Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.

Have a documented system another creator could follow.

Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.

What You Will Do

  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations : new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).

Who You Are

  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting : hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.

Core Values

  • Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.
  • Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.
  • Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.
  • Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.
  • Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.

Offer Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

Your portfolio (required if you have it)

A short note on your AI + editing workflow

2–3 examples you’re most proud of and why they worked

If you don’t have a portfolio but you’re sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you’ll prove yourself fast.

title: Viral Video Content Creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role. We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads.

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools

Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily

Success Criteria

First 30 days: Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.

Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).

Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).

Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.

By 90 days Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.

Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).

Maintain a simple testing system : what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.

Become independent : you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.

By 12 months Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.

Have a documented system another creator could follow.

Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.

What You Will Do

  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations : new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).

Who You Are

  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting : hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.

Core Values

  • Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.
  • Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.
  • Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.

Our clients come to us because they need consistent, qualified meetings, and they stay because our process is intelligent, results-driven, and without any BS. What sets LGH apart is our selective, performance-based network. Descrição da vaga

Company Description

Outroll is a software holding company that specializes in managing, building, and acquiring software products. With a focus on turning legacy systems, custom tools, and internal software into efficient solutions, we provide a permanent home for software. Our digital infrastructure, development frameworks, and distributed workforce enable us to create world‑class digital products and ventures.

About the Role

We're seeking a talented Senior Full‑Stack Developer to join our remote team on a permanent full‑time contract basis. This fully remote position is open to candidates based in Brazil, offering the flexibility to work from anywhere while contributing to exciting projects. You'll play a key role in architecting, developing, and maintaining robust web applications, collaborating with cross‑functional teams in an agile environment. This is an opportunity to work on scalable platforms that emphasize security, performance, and seamless user experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable back‑end architectures using PHP frameworks, ensuring high performance, security, and extensibility.
  • Develop responsive front‑end interfaces with modern JavaScript tools and CSS frameworks, focusing on intuitive UX/UI.

  • Ensure compliance with security best practices, including authentication, access controls, and performance optimizations.
  • Contribute to documentation, code reviews, and knowledge sharing within a global team.

Requirements

  • Proven experience (5+ years) as a full‑stack developer, with strong expertise in PHP and Symfony (versions 6-8).

  • Solid front‑end skills with tools such as Turbo, Stimulus, Tailwind CSS, and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with database management (e.g., relational databases like SQLite or similar), schema design, and migrations.
  • Experience in agile methodologies, with the ability to adapt to flexible project scopes and sprints.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to writing clean, maintainable code.
  • Excellent English communication skills for collaborating with an international team.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Must be based in Brazil and eligible to work on a full‑time contract basis.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work with flexible hours to support work‑life balance.
  • Permanent full‑time contract with opportunities for long‑term growth in a venture‑building environment.
  • Collaborative culture with access to ongoing training, support, and the latest tools.
  • The chance to work on innovative projects that make a difference, backed by a team of experts.

Remuneration

The remuneration will be based on experience and productivity.

Location

This role requires that the candidate is located in Brazil and have full working rights.

title: Staff Engineer – Ia Generativa
description:
Sua carreira com liberdade e propósito

Na Remessa Online, não se trata apenas de transferências internacionais, criamos conexões que rompem fronteiras e transformam realidades. Somos movidos pela ousadia, respeito, colaboração, encantamento e responsabilidade.

Nosso segredo? Trabalhar juntos com transparência, comprometimento e autonomia, sempre buscando a melhor solução. Estamos revolucionando o cenário financeiro global, e você pode fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!

Como vai ser o seu dia a dia

Você fará parte do time de AI e será uma das principais referências técnicas da área na Remessa Online. Buscamos alguém que respire inovação, tenha resiliência, curiosidade intelectual e capacidade de atuar em cenários ambíguos e em constante evolução.

Como Staff Engineer de AI, você será responsável por definir a visão técnica de AI da companhia e conectá-la diretamente aos nossos desafios de negócio, B2B, B2C, operações, marketing, compliance e muito mais.

  • Dar continuidade e construir uma arquitetura de AI para suportar a implementação de inteligência artificial dentro dos times de desenvolvimento e dos times de negócio;
  • Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de AI de ponta a ponta, desde a exploração (discovery, spikes, POCs) até a implantação em produção e evolução contínua;
  • Trabalhar próximo de Produto, Dados, Operações, Marketing e demais times de Engenharia para identificar oportunidades reais de uso de AI que gerem impacto em receita, eficiência e experiência do cliente;
  • Apoiar a construção de produtos como chatbots executivos, copilotos internos, soluções de automação operacional e modelos de recomendação, sempre com foco em geração de valor mensurável;
  • Desenhar e evoluir a arquitetura de AI (modelos, pipelines, MLOps, observabilidade, segurança, governança de dados) garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e compliance;
  • Ser mentor(a) técnico(a) para outros engenheiros(as), disseminando boas práticas de AI / ML, engenharia de software e arquitetura em múltiplos times;
  • Atuar forte em discovery técnico : conduzir spikes, avaliar trade-offs de modelos (LLMs, modelos clássicos de ML, modelos proprietários vs open source) e apoiar decisões de build vs buy;
  • Ajudar a definir padrões, guidelines e frameworks internos para uso de AI, incluindo boas práticas de prompt engineering, avaliação de modelos, uso de vetores, privacidade e proteção de dados;
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, da concepção de produto e da arquitetura de soluções, garantindo coerência entre requisitos funcionais, não-funcionais e as capacidades dos modelos;

Incentivar documentação técnica clara (arquitetura, decisões, modelos, pipelines) e promover melhoria contínua no nosso codebase e na nossa plataforma de AI.

Nos preocupamos com coerência, segurança e responsabilidade no uso de AI. Usamos spikes e slack time para experimentar novas ideias, validar hipóteses e reduzir risco técnico antes de escalar soluções. Buscamos sempre pensar “fora da caixa”, mas com disciplina de engenharia e métricas de impacto bem definidas.

O que você precisa saber para se juntar ao nosso time

  • Forte base em arquitetura e design de software (Domain-Driven Design, design de APIs, event-driven, microsserviços etc.);
  • Experiência prática construindo soluções de Machine Learning e / ou LLMs em produção (modelos de classificação, recomendação, NLP, generative AI, RAG etc.);
  • Conhecimento em modelos Classificadores / Decisores;
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados vetorizados e baseados em Grafos(pgvector, pgrouting, Neo4J, ApacheAGE);
  • Experiência em observabilidade em aplicações GenAI e / ou integrações com modelos de ML;
  • Conhecimento em NodeJs / TypeScript ou Python;
  • Boas práticas de engenharia (TDD, clean code, testes automatizados);
  • Experiência com FinMLOps : versionamento de modelos e dados, experiment tracking, CI / CD para modelos, monitoramento de drift e performance, pipelines de treinamento e inferência;
  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas de LLM e boas práticas de uso (prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, avaliação de qualidade, custo e latência);
  • Experiência com integração de APIs de modelos (OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI ou similares) e / ou modelos open source self-hosted;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, conseguindo traduzir temas complexos de AI para diferentes públicos (negócio, liderança, engenharia, operações);

Interesse genuíno em colocar AI no centro da estratégia da empresa, com mentalidade de produto + plataforma.

Será um diferencial

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, pagamentos, câmbio, conta global ou produtos financeiros regulados;
  • Atuação anterior ajudando a estruturar plataformas internas de AI muti-agents;
  • Conhecimento de Kanban, Kanbanize e KMM para gestão de fluxo de trabalho;

Inglês para leitura e participação em discussões técnicas internacionais.

O que oferecemos

Contrato CLT – Todos os direitos garantidos.

Bônus por metas – Recebimento de bônus atrelado ao cumprimento de objetivos organizacionais.

Plano de saúde e odontológico – Cobertura para você e seus dependentes via SulAmérica.

VR e VA flexíveis – Créditos no Caju para usar como quiser.

Auxílio Home Office – Suporte para despesas e equipamentos.

Auxílio Creche – Apoio para mães e pais.

Licenças Estendidas – Maternidade e paternidade ampliadas para você aproveitar esse momento especial.

Auxílio Dependentes – Suporte para quem tem dependentes com necessidades especiais.

Seguro de Vida – Tranquilidade e segurança para você.

Descontos na Remessa Online – Para viver sem fronteiras!

Bem-estar e saúde – Consultas online com psicólogos e nutricionistas via Conexa Saúde e Psicologia Viva.

Wellhub – Acesso a academias e serviços como mindfulness, nutrição e terapia.

Apoio ao Empregado (EAP) – Suporte especializado sempre que precisar.

Day Off no Aniversário – Seu dia especial merece folga!

Ciclo de Desenvolvimento e Treinamentos – Desafios, capacitações e avaliação 360° para impulsionar sua carreira.

Atuação

Remoto : Trabalhe de onde quiser! Se preferir um escritório, temos espaço em São Paulo. Flexibilidade é o nosso lema.

Diversidade e Inclusão : Construindo o Futuro!

Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece e nos impulsiona a ir além. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas! Queremos um ambiente onde cada voz seja ouvida, cada experiência valorizada e cada contribuição faça a diferença.

Mais do que um compromisso, essa é a nossa realidade : um lugar acolhedor, respeitoso e representativo, onde juntos construímos um futuro mais justo, inclusivo e inspirador.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

  • Conhecimento avançado em Azure e serviços de nuvem.
  • Vivência com arquitetura de microsserviços orientados a eventos .

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

  • Create and maintain integrations between internal systems and third-party platforms using APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architectures
  • Develop data pipelines that transform, enrich, and route information across multiple systems and data sources
  • Implement prompt engineering strategies and design multi-step LLM orchestration workflows

  • Monitor automation health, debug failures, and continuously optimize workflows for reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency
  • Identify new automation opportunities by collaborating directly with operations, product, and engineering teams
  • Document workflows, create runbooks, and establish best practices for scalable AI automation
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to shared automation libraries, frameworks, and templates
  • Measure and report on automation performance metrics, including accuracy, latency, cost savings, and operational impact
  • Prototype new AI capabilities and experiment with emerging technologies as part of our Technical Innovation Program
  • Example Projects & Initiatives To give you a sense of the types of challenges you’ll tackle, here are examples of projects our AI Automation Engineers work on:

  • Intelligent Document Processing:

    • Build systems that automatically extract structured data from unstructured documents (PDFs, emails, images)
    • Create validation workflows that use AI to verify data accuracy and flag anomalies for human review
    • Design document classification systems that route different document types to appropriate processing pipelines
    • Implement OCR + LLM workflows that handle handwritten or poorly scanned documents

  • AI-Powered Business Process Automation:

    • Develop AI agents that conduct multi-step research and qualification processes autonomously
    • Build conversational systems that handle routine inquiries and escape complex cases appropriately
    • Create intelligent routing and matching systems that optimize business outcomes using historical data and ML models
    • Design automated scheduling and coordination systems that handle complex business logic and constraints

  • System Integration & Data Orchestration:

    • Connect internal platforms with external third-party services, handling authentication, rate limiting, and error recovery
    • Build real-time data synchronization pipelines that keep multiple systems consistent
    • Create webhook listeners and event processors that trigger automated workflows based on external events
    • Design data enrichment pipelines that pull information from multiple sources and merge it intelligently

  • Operational Intelligence & Monitoring:

    • Build automated alerting and notification systems that detect anomalies and trigger appropriate responses
    • Create dashboards and reporting workflows that aggregate data from multiple sources
    • Develop predictive systems that use historical patterns to forecast operational needs
    • Design automated quality control systems that continuously validate data accuracy across systems

    • AI Innovation & Experimentation:

      • Prototype new AI capabilities using the latest LLM models and techniques
      • Experiment with vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG)
      • Build proof-of-concepts that demonstrate the business value of emerging AI technologies
      • Contribute to our Technical Innovation Program (TIP) with novel automation approaches

    • Platform & Infrastructure:

      • Develop reusable automation components, templates, and design patterns
      • Create internal tooling that makes it easier for other teams to build and deploy automations
      • Establish monitoring, logging, and observability standards for automation workflows
      • Build testing frameworks that ensure automation reliability and catch regressions
    • These projects span multiple teams and business functions - you’ll have the opportunity to work on whatever creates the most business value, from carrier operations to customer experience to internal productivity tools.

title: Técnico(a) de Contratos
description:
Job description

Estamos em busca de um profissional comprometido e organizado para atuar como membro em nossa equipe de gestão de contratos. Essa função é responsável por controlar e acompanhar os contratos residentes de prestação de serviços de manutenção, fibra de vidro, acesso por andaime pintura industrial, içamento de carga, plataformas aéreas, caldeiraria, ar-condicionado e instalações elétricas prediais, buscando prover meios para a realização dos trabalhos, observando o cumprimento das normas e procedimentos estabelecidos e fiscalizando o cumprimento do escopo de serviços definido no contrato.

Main responsibilities

  • Fazer visitas às áreas emitentes de notificações de serviços para checagem e levantamento de informações, escopo dos serviços, croquis, etc., a fim de elaborar detalhamentos;
  • Coordenar as atividades dos contratos residentes de revestimento de borracha, revestimento de fibra de vidro, obras civis, acesso por andaime, pintura industrial e máquina de carga, garantindo a perfeita execução técnica, performance e eficiência, através de interface constante com usuários internos das empresas contratadas;
  • Orientar as empresas contratadas pela TRONOX quanto ao cumprimento de todos os requisitos legais, normas e procedimentos internos;
  • Conferir em conjunto com o líder imediato o “check-list” de obrigações a ser cumpridas pela empresa prestadora de serviço, para sua regularização junto a TRONOX;
  • Definir com as áreas de manutenção, operação e terceiros o detalhamento de serviços de obras civis, pintura industrial e montagem de andaime em função dos critérios estabelecidos (prioridade dos serviços, atividades desenvolvidas, materiais e recursos necessários, etc.);
  • Elaborar planejamento para execução de obras civis e pintura industrial da manutenção;
  • Emite as Permissões de Trabalho (PT’s) na sua área de atuação e outros documentos tais como: Notificações de Serviços, Requisições de Almoxarifado, etc.;
  • Efetuar medições dos serviços contratados, para liberação das faturas conforme contrato;
  • Realizar auditoria de segurança nas empresas prestadoras de serviços em geral nos itens correspondentes a condição de segurança dos EPI’s e ferramentas manuais e eletros-portáteis;
  • Elaborar cronograma de atividades utilizando o MS Project;
  • Acompanhar a execução dos serviços programados, mantendo contato com supervisores de manutenção, executantes e empresas contratadas;
  • Elaborar orçamentos detalhados dos recursos necessários à realização dos serviços conforme planilha de preço dos contratos existentes;
  • Elaborar a programação de serviços, conforme disponibilidade de recursos humanos (Homem-hora) materiais, equipamentos, ferramentas, etc., detalhando serviços a serem executados;
  • Manter contato com as diversas áreas, para liberação dos equipamentos, definição de escopo, detalhamento, priorização e programação dos serviços com recursos de terceiros;
  • Operar o sistema de manutenção informatizado (MAC), efetuando os respectivos registros e atualizando as informações cadastradas, de acordo com as informações verificadas na área, relacionado às empresas contratadas, para emissão das Ordens de Serviços (O.S.);
  • Participar do comitê de segurança das contratadas;
  • Dar suporte nas definições de projeto e implementações de construção civil;
  • Aprovar fechamento de custos dos serviços contratados sob sua responsabilidade.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação técnica em Mecânica, Instrumentação, Eletrotécnica ou Eletromecânica.
  • Mínimo de 06 anos de experiência em atividades similares de gestão de contratos de serviços industriais.

A elegibilidade de alguns benefícios depende de tempo mínimo de permanência na empresa.

Main responsibilities

Supervisionar as operações de coleta externa, realizadas no domicílio do cliente (coleta de exames e vacinas), assegurando a execução dos processos conforme os padrões estabelecidos, o adequado funcionamento da operação, o alcance dos indicadores da área e a satisfação dos clientes, por meio da liderança direta da equipe e do acompanhamento operacional.

Gestão de Pessoas

  • Realizar a gestão do ponto eletrônico da equipe, assegurando conformidade com a jornada de trabalho.
  • Conduzir o processo de avaliação de desempenho anual e apoiar a elaboração e acompanhamento dos Planos de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).
  • Gerir férias, escalas de feriados e finais de semana, garantindo a continuidade e eficiência da operação.

Gestão Operacional

  • Gerenciar o painel de agendamento dos atendimentos domiciliares, assegurando organização, eficiência e cumprimento dos prazos.
  • Monitorar e acompanhar as rotas de atendimento, buscando otimização de tempo, recursos e qualidade do serviço.
  • Realizar o controle de quilometragem (KM) dos veículos utilizados na operação.
  • Acompanhar os processos técnicos de coleta e vacinação domiciliar, garantindo aderência aos protocolos e procedimentos estabelecidos.

Indicadores e Controles

  • Acompanhar e analisar os indicadores da área (straws), apoiando a implementação de ações de melhoria.
  • Monitorar planilhas de controle de insumos, Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPI) e registros de temperatura, assegurando conformidade e rastreabilidade.
  • Acompanhar os indicadores operacionais e de qualidade da área, reportando resultados à coordenação.

Gestão de Sistemas e Documentação

  • Realizar a gestão e acompanhamento dos sistemas operacionais da área.
  • Manter a documentação da área atualizada, garantindo organização e conformidade com normas internas e externas.
  • Controlar a validade da CNH dos colaboradores e do CRLV dos veículos utilizados na operação.

Atendimento ao Cliente e RECs

  • Atender clientes para esclarecimento de dúvidas e orientações técnicas relacionadas aos serviços de coleta e vacinação domiciliar.
  • Acompanhar os registros de RECs, realizando análise, tratativa e retorno ao cliente quando aplicável.
  • Manter contato com clientes envolvidos em RECs, garantindo comunicação clara, empática e resolutiva.

Requirements and skills

  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano com Gestão de Pessoas e Serviço de Coleta domiciliar;

description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role:

At Oowlish, we help growing brands turn Shopify into atrue e-commerce growth engine—not just a storefront . As we evolve from execution-focused delivery tolong-term strategic partnership , we’re looking for anE-Commerce (Shopify) Practice Lead to own and scale our Shopify practice.

The core of this position isstrategy, consulting, and ownership . You will act as themain point of contact for Shopify clients , deeply understanding their business, diagnosing opportunities, and guiding them towardmeasurable improvements in Conversion Rate, AOV, UX/UI, SEO, Site-Speed, Promotions, and overall e-commerce performance .

You’ll work closely with developers and designers bysetting priorities, defining scope, and ensuring high-quality delivery—without being responsible for writing code or implementing features yourself . Your role is totranslate business objectives into clear, actionable roadmaps and guide execution through the team, ensuring that work delivered hasa measurable business impact .

In addition, this role has a strongcommercial and growth component . You will identifyupsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts, contribute tonew proposals and pre-sales conversations , and help position Shopify as along-term growth partner for clients .

This position is ideal for someone whothinks like a business owner , communicates confidently with stakeholders, and knows how to balancestrategy, delivery, and revenue growth within Shopify ecosystems.

Client Ownership & Strategy:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of Shopify clients.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client’s business, customers, and goals.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve conversion, revenue, and user experience.
  • Translate business objectives into a clear, prioritized Shopify roadmap.

CRO & Performance Optimization:

  • Analyze store performance using Shopify Analytics, GA4, and other tools.
  • Identify conversion bottlenecks and optimization opportunities across the funnel.
  • Propose and prioritize CRO initiatives and experiments.
  • Track results and clearly communicate impact to clients.

UX/UI Collaboration

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to ensure designs are conversion-focused and Shopify-friendly.
  • Provide feedback grounded in usability, performance, and business impact.
  • Maintain a high bar for visual quality and user experience.

SEO & Shopify Best Practices:

  • Ensure Shopify stores follow SEO and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with designers and developers to embed SEO into UX and technical decisions.
  • Make smart use of Shopify features, themes, and apps to maximize value.

Delivery & Team Coordination:

  • Plan and manage the workload of Shopify developers.
  • Break initiatives into clear, actionable tasks and priorities.
  • Ensure high-quality, on-time delivery across all client work.
  • Act as a quality gate before work reaches clients.

Account Growth & Business Development:

  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Help scope new initiatives and support sales conversations when needed.
  • Strengthen long-term client relationships by delivering consistent value.

Must have:

  • 5+ years of experience in e-commerce, ideally with a strong Shopify focus.
  • Proven experience improving conversion rates and online store performance.
  • Deep understanding of Shopify (admin, themes, apps ecosystem).
  • Strong knowledge of CRO, UX/UI principles, and SEO fundamentals.
  • Experience working closely with developers and designers.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with clients.
  • Fluent or advanced English proficiency (written and spoken) is required , as this role involves direct communication with international clients.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in an agency or consulting environment.
  • Shopify Plus experience.
  • Familiarity with tools like Hotjar, Klaviyo, and A/B testing platforms.
  • Experience supporting sales or account growth.
  • Portuguese and/or Spanish proficiency (written and spoken) is a strong plus, especially for working with international clients.

If you enjoythinking like a business owner , care deeply aboutgreat UX , and know how toturn Shopify into a growth engine , we’d love to hear from you.

Apply and let’s talk.

- Strategic Impact: Redefine how software is built.

- Innovation Hub: A collaborative environment where your vision directly shapes our competitive edge in the market.

- Comprehensive Package: Competitive salary, stock options, and premium benefits.

description:
Analista de Atração e Seleção Pleno - Salvador/BA

Somos um grupo multimarcas que atua na comercialização de veículos novos, seminovos, acessórios, consórcios, frota, seguros e pós-vendas realizado na nossa rede de concessionárias além do serviço de locação (mobilidade).

Buscamos um Analista de Atração e Seleção Pleno para executar os processos de recrutamento e seleção do Grupo, visando a atração de talentos que atendam às necessidades das diferentes áreas, garantindo a eficiência, assertividade e alinhamento cultural nas contratações, atuando de forma consultiva com os(as) gestores(as) e buscando soluções inovadoras para melhoria dos processos.

Se você é uma pessoa ágil, que encanta o cliente e preza pela excelência em resultados, venha fazer parte do nossotime !

Nós somos o Grupo NewChase e crescemos juntos!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar a divulgação das vagas em diferentes canais e plataformas.
  • Conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta, desde o alinhamento de perfil da vaga até a escolha final do(a) candidato(a) e encerramento da vaga, incluindo todas as etapas de entrevistas e testes.
  • Atuar ativamente na busca de candidatos em plataformas digitais, como LinkedIn, sites especializados e bancos de talentos.
  • Alinhar os perfis das vagas com os(as) gestores(as) de cada área, proporcionando um atendimento consultivo sobre as necessidades do recrutamento.
  • Conduzir Entrevistas por Competência, aplicação de testes técnicos, além de realizar análises mais aprofundadas dos perfis dos(as) candidatos(as), visando a melhor aderência às posições.
  • Organizar a agenda de entrevistas com os(as) gestores(as) e candidatos(as), acompanhando os processos para garantir o cumprimento dos prazos.
  • Elaborar e documentar os pareceres dos(as) profissionais avaliados(as).
  • Manter comunicação ativa com os(as) candidatos(as), fornecendo informações sobre o andamento do processo seletivo e feedbacks após as entrevistas.
  • Realizar o controle e acompanhamento das vagas em aberto, visando garantir o SLA definido para cada posição.
  • Acompanhar e conduzir o processo admissional de novos colaboradores(as), realizando o encaminhamento para realização do exame admissional, coleta de documentação e envio das informações para a área de Administração de Pessoas finalizar o processo e garantir que haja a integração do novo colaborador(a) à cultura do Grupo.
  • Acompanhar os principais indicadores de recrutamento, incluindo tempo médio de fechamento e satisfação dos gestores.
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de estratégias para fortalecimento da marca empregadora.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Psicologia, Gestão de Recursos Humanos ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência em Recrutamento e Seleção, preferencialmente em grandes volumes.
  • Experiência na condução de entrevistas por competência.
  • Conhecimento no uso de plataformas digitais para hunting.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de recrutamento (ATS).

Será considerado um diferencial se você:

  • Vivência na análise de indicadores será um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office, especialmente em Excel.

Informações adicionais

O que oferecemos:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • WellHub(Antigo Gympass) - extensivo para até 3 dependentes;
  • Telemedicina sem custo - extensivo para cônjuge, filhos e filhas;
  • Atendimento Psicológico sem custo - extensivo para cônjuge, filhos e filhas;
  • Descontos em cursos de Graduação, Pós Graduação, MBA e Inglês 100% online;
  • Universidade Corporativa;
  • Programa de Reconhecimento por tempo de empresa;
  • Programa de Atenção à Gestante;

Etapas do processo

  • Etapa 3: Teste de Redação 3 Teste de Redação
  • Etapa 6: Contratação 6 Contratação

Somos um grupo de mobilidade com destaque nacional no mercado automotivo, com mais de 30 anos de excelência em serviço e crescimento contínuo. Iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1991 em Vitória da Conquista/BA, hoje presentes em 8 estados do Brasil (Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Minas Gerais, Pará, Pernambuco, Sergipe e Tocantins).

Ao longo dos anos, expandimos nossos negócios significativamente, contando atualmente com mais de 40 lojas distribuídas entre as montadoras Toyota, Lexus, BMW, Mini, Audi, Volvo, Chery, Chevrolet, Hyundai, Volkswagen e GNC Seminovos. Além disso, temos o Customer Retention Center, nosso centro responsável por toda a estratégia e monitoramento digital do Grupo.

  • Programas de Desenvolvimento profissional.

O Grupo NewChase destaca-se por sua constante busca pela inovação, humanização, e concentramos nossos esforços em um único propósito:

“Oferecer e entregar aos nossos (as) clientes, colaboradores (as) e parceiros (as), os melhores resultados em sua excelência, sendo reconhecido pelo DNA de #VelocidadeeQualidade”

description:
Job description

Ser um LMer é muito mais do que ser um funcionário da empresa LM Soluções de Mobilidade; é fazer parte de uma organização colaborativa onde todos têm espaço para se desenvolver e compartilhar o melhor de si.

Somos uma empresa impulsionada por pessoas, por isso, nosso jeito de Ser e Fazer é fundamentalmente direcionado a como nos relacionamos com todos ao nosso redor: entre funcionários, parceiros, fornecedores, investidores e clientes.

  • Comunicação;
  • Negociação;
  • Administração do tempo e atividades;

title: Data Engineer
description:
Hey, Dev, check the opportunity we have here at Brick Abode!

About Brick Abode

We are a software development company that serves clients from multiple countries around the world, with differing technological needs. Therefore, we value a good computer science base.

Contractors with a solid understanding of the basic building blocks of today’s technology are really welcome and thrive at Brick Abode.

People here are given autonomy, not put into a box to work only on one thing. They are in touch with the business needs of our clients, sometimes communicating with them directly.

We challenge ourselves to learn new things and go outside our comfort zone. Candidates who are up to the challenge will have an amazing career with us.

If you feel that your values fit with Brick Abode culture, check below for further details about this Position.

What kind of professional are we looking for?

We’re looking for a responsible and proactive professional who can navigate between technology and business contexts with ease, feel comfortable in fast‑paced environments, and have great communication skills.

Our team is Brazil and USA‑based, and communication is in English. The position is fully remote.

What do I need to have to apply for this position?

  • Python (with strong data handling experience): ETL pipelines, familiarity with DataFrames (Pandas or similar)
  • Familiarity with the AWS Cloud ecosystem
  • CI/CD and code hygiene for data pipelines
  • An academic background (MSc or PhD) will also be a plus

As Contractor (PJ), you will have:

  • Work with international clients with international standards
  • Opportunity to grow as a leader
  • Possibility to move between teams
  • Speak in English with your coworkers
  • 2 weeks of paid leave per year
  • National holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid marriage leave
  • Working with a company that cares about our people and their personal growth
  • All expenses paid for training, conferences, and online courses
  • Health Care Plan - Online

If you are passionate about technology and have a strong desire to work on cutting‑edge projects, we encourage you to apply for this position!

Submit your CV to make sure it contains your LinkedIn and GitHub accounts.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

Criada em 21 de fevereiro de 1937 pelo Professor José Silveira, a Fundação José Silveira (FJS) vem ampliando sua obra em um processo de crescimento sustentável, firmado no planejamento estratégico e foco nos melhores resultados. Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.

É o que demonstra o trabalho de referência das nossas unidades em áreas como combate à tuberculose, assistência neonatal, parto humanizado, tratamento do câncer de mama e reabilitação de pacientes com deficiências neuropsicomotoras, intelectuais e autismo. Por ano, são mais de 1,2 milhão de atendimentos realizados. A FJS promove, ainda, ações de prevenção e promoção da saúde e socioambientais voltadas às comunidades de Salvador e de municípios do interior da Bahia, contribuindo para a melhoria dos indicadores sociais e de saúde no estado.

  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas de LLM e boas práticas de uso (prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, avaliação de qualidade, custo e latência);

As a Software Engineer on the macOS team, you'll help build and scale Speechify's core desktop experience for millions of users. You'll own significant parts of our macOS app architecture, ship production-ready code, and collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams across the company. This is a key role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, enjoys making high-impact product decisions, loves delightful user experiences, and has a passion for accessibility and performance.

Why Join Speechify?

At Speechify, we ship fast, build for real users, and care deeply about quality and accessibility. You'll work on products that change lives, and your contributions will shape both the product and the company.

How to Apply

description:

Há 88 anos, a Fundação José Silveira mantém o olhar voltado para o futuro, reinventando suas práticas em um mundo imprevisível, sem perder de vista suas raízes sólidas naquilo que é a origem do propósito: cuidar da saúde e melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

Com isso, buscamos pessoas conectadas ao novo que venham contribuir com o constante crescimento e a perpetuação do nosso legado.

Junte-se ao nosso propósito!

  • Elaborar, auxiliar e colaborar na criação de projetos para execução na FJS;
  • Elaborar documentos para tramitação interna na Fundação José Silveira (FJS) e de submissão Ética de protocolos ao Comitê de Ética em Pesquisa (CEP/CONEP);
  • Supervisionar e orientar a coleta dados de participantes de pesquisa;
  • Criar, ajudar a criar e revisar banco de dados para estudos;
  • Selecionar e acompanhar participantes de protocolos de pesquisa.
  • Aplicar o termo de consentimento livre e esclarecido (TCLE) (para a inclusão de participantes em projetos de pesquisa);
  • Realizar envio adequadamente de amostras clínicas tanto locais, como nacionais e internacionais;
  • Incluir dados dos participantes e outras informações em banco de dados e revisão de dados de participantes de estudos;
  • Fazer e auxiliar na análise de dados de projetos de pesquisa e projetos da FJS;
  • Escrever e corrigir artigos para publicação científica;
  • Supervisionar e orientar estagiários na execução de atividades que contribuem para a execução das ações do Centro de Pesquisa;
  • Produzir e analisar relatórios mensais e indicadores.
  • Promover, colaborar e ensinar em cursos que envolvem pesquisa, como criação de banco de dados, epidemiologia e/ou metodologia de pesquisa;
  • Elaborar, acompanhar e executar procedimentos operacionais padronizados para protocolos de pesquisa.
  • Ensino superior completo em de saúde com formação de mestrado e/ou doutorado na área de saúde, com foco em epidemiologia;
  • Possuir conhecimento sobre processos regulatórios; análise de dados em pacote estatístico; escrita científica
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Clube de vantagens do colaborador;
  • Clube da saúde para o colaborador
  • Step 2: Entrevista por competência RH 2 Entrevista por competência RH
  • Step 4: Avaliação médica 4 Avaliação médica

Criada em 21 de fevereiro de 1937 pelo Professor José Silveira, a Fundação José Silveira (FJS) vem ampliando sua obra em um processo de crescimento sustentável, firmado no planejamento estratégico e foco nos melhores resultados. Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.

É o que demonstra o trabalho de referência das nossas unidades em áreas como combate à tuberculose, assistência neonatal, parto humanizado, tratamento do câncer de mama e reabilitação de pacientes com deficiências neuropsicomotoras, intelectuais e autismo. Por ano, são mais de 1,2 milhão de atendimentos realizados. A FJS promove, ainda, ações de prevenção e promoção da saúde e socioambientais voltadas às comunidades de Salvador e de municípios do interior da Bahia, contribuindo para a melhoria dos indicadores sociais e de saúde no estado.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Front-End | Hablla
description:
Sobre a Hablla

A Hablla é a plataforma líder em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI) — uma evolução do RevOps que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Business Performance em um único fluxo conversacional.

Nosso propósito é redefinir a comunicação entre marcas e pessoas, utilizando Inteligência Artificial Generativa e automação inteligente para transformar dados em resultados concretos.

Se você busca desafios técnicos, quer trabalhar com produtos digitais de alta escala e participar da construção de uma solução proprietária inovadora essa parceria é para você.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver interfaces modernas e de alta performance utilizando React.js e TypeScript, com foco em escalabilidade, responsividade e experiência do usuário.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares de UX, backend, dados e produto, em um ambiente de desenvolvimento ágil.
  • Participar da definição e manutenção do Design System e dos padrões de arquitetura front-end.
  • Implementar e manter o gerenciamento de estado utilizando Redux com Redux-Saga.
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica do código, seguindo boas práticas de clean code e componentização.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com React.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/Tailwind e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Domínio de Redux e Redux-Saga.
  • Experiência com Vite ou Next.js.
  • Conhecimento de Git e GitHub para versionamento e colaboração.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de Clean Architecture, Hooks, componentização e testes unitários.
  • Mentalidade orientada a produto, com foco em performance e experiência do usuário.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com integrações omnichannel (WhatsApp, Meta, e-mail e telefonia).
  • Experiência com Figma e colaboração com times de UX/UI.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas colaborativos em tempo real.
  • Interesse em IA aplicada à interface e personalização de jornada do usuário.
  • Ter trabalhado em ferramentas de CRM e/ou Omnichannel.

O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente 100% remoto e colaborativo.
  • Cultura ágil, horizontal e orientada a resultados.
  • Contato direto com os founders e time de produto.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em uma startup em expansão internacional.

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Desenvolvimento Java + Kotlin AWS

Monitorar, otimizar e manter os serviços e recursos AWS para garantir alta disponibilidade e custo-benefício. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outros desenvolvedores e stakeholders para alinhar requisitos de negócio com soluções técnicas. Participar ativamente em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a produção. Proficiência em AWS, com experiência prática em serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, SSM entre outros.
